bio_text: Colin Lowenberg is an engineer, entrepreneur, and ecosystem builder with 20 years of experience spanning wireless networking, Web3 developer relations, and AI infrastructure. Currently Developer Advocate at Nebius, he bridges the gap between cutting-edge GPU cloud infrastructure and the builders who use it, while also running Dabl.Club, SF's independent builder community. His background spans Accenture, Cisco, Consensys, and hands-on agentic AI tooling built on top of Nebius.
